items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I bought the horn through Larry Barberan

ctx.x: I don't know. He can't. Well he could still play now. He plays all right now but I guess not as well as it used to. Not as well as it used to. Um yeah and so. I was going to say some people like the Leblanc clarinet. Some people think they're the best nowadays. They're made in France but they're put together over in this country.

Oh really? Leblanc. I have a Leblanc case but but it's not a Leblanc clarinet. I can't call the name of that horn. I bought from Peterson. Uh it's a French horn though. It's French? Yeah it's a French horn. Yeah like a buffet. It's a French horn. It's a French horn. It's a French horn. It's a French horn. It's a French horn. It might come to the later. Yeah. I can't think of the name of it but it seems to be a pretty good horn. Uh what the boy said is well you see it sounds no I'll tell you I bought a horn…

Well I was going to ask who were some of the clarinetists that you liked when you were young and getting started. You mentioned all those trumpet players like Punch and Kid Rene. Who were some of the better clarinetists when you were young learning that you liked to hear?
